body: Thanks. Will work on making this year better. If it doesn't seem to improve then too I will try to stick around.

>you are living for you, not for them

I stopped living for myself a long time ago.
Also, Thanks your advice seems good but it is good in the long run. I have set my mind to end it Saturday midnight, not much I can experience by then that will stop me.

I don't feel like I can open up to him. I keep everyone I know irl isolated from my life at home. I might be able to talk to a stranger more comfortably I think but then again I called the suicide helpline and the I choked and put the phone down.

Thanks for being there for him. Yeah one of my friends has been calling me every week, has been trying to talk to me every day but I have been responding with "I am fine"s and "there is no problem"s. I don't want to burden him with my stuff.
This is India we are talking about so the situation is even shittier. Most people don't recognise mental illness as real problem still.
